section_intro:
The DEFINITION layer is the URM's entry point: it fixes what object every later layer is about. This paragraph carries no claim of its own — every substantive statement in this section lives in a block below with its model function, its gate, its grounding, its rows and its scope, and what follows is only how to read them. Every rows cell in this layer prints FORMAL, DEFINED or PARTIAL; none prints PROVED, and the two PROVED rows named in §0.1 are cited nowhere here. FORMAL is real mathematics about the program's own stipulated definition and says nothing about the world by itself (H-3, PARTIAL, UNAUDITED), and that reading governs the blocks that put a named real surface inside the definition exactly as it governs the ones about DEF-A, the exact corner — P-DEF-1 among them, whose row C-69 (FORMAL, SINGLE-CARRIER) the solidity review demoted from PROVED on 2026-08-20.

The layer's hole belongs before the blocks and not after them, and each block that owns a piece of it says so in its own scope cell. The fact the whole definition turns on — that the world's records fail the exact clauses — is narrated from sealed lanes and fires no validator gate (P-DEF-2), and so are the support-compression argument (P-DEF-3), the region census behind clause (v) (P-DEF-6) and the derivation reading (P-DEF-9). Measured against D-25's stage (3), which P-DEF-7 states and which fixes every proof step as a model function with its validator gate and its grounding, that is where this layer falls short: the one fact the definition rests on is the one a physicist handed the model cannot rerun through it. And the question H-3 asks — why THIS definition — this layer does not answer; P-DEF-9 carries it open.

claims.headline: what a record is: the amended clauses (i')-(v') on carrier ⊗ local bath
claims.prose: A record is a commuting spectral family on carrier ⊗ local bath satisfying the amended clauses (i')-(v') with a declared tolerance tuple: durable to t_m (ii'); non-constant on the closed system's energy shell of width sqrt(C_v k_B T^2) (iii'); writable by an energy-conserving dilation unitary at free-energy floor kT ln2 + dE_config (iv'); protected, with every single-region flip costing at least E_b at E_b/kT >> 1 (v'). ProjectModel.clauses evaluates (ii')-(v') from a surface's own SI constants — dE, E_b, T, f0 — together with the declared t_m, C_v and write work W. Clause (i') is not computed: the model returns spectral_family = True for every surface it accepts. On the CoCrPt grain at K_u = 2.0e5 J/m^3, V = 1.26e-24 m^3, T = 300 K, f0 = 1e9 Hz, dE = 3kT = 1.243e-20 J, E_b = 2.52e-19 J, W = 5e-19 J, C_v = 1e-3 J/K, and t_m fixed independently at the 10-year retention spec, the four computed clauses pass: decay rate 3.965e-18 /s against 1/t_m = 3.169e-9 /s, a margin of 8.0e8x; shell 3.525e-11 J against dE_config, 2.84e9x; W against the free-energy floor 1.530e-20 J, 32.7x the floor and 174x Landauer alone; and E_b/kT = 60.8 with Arrhenius suppression 3.78e-27. The control beside those four passes is the same grain under DEF-A, where all four exact clauses fail: the jump operators do not commute with the record, H is non-degenerate so any commuting R is a function of H, max|Tr(P_E R)| = 1.0000 where 0 is required, and the write head flips it locally at 5e-19 J. The amendment is not cosmetic. What the (ii') margin is made of, per C-69's demotion: the rates ARE the inserted Arrhenius jump strengths, read back through the record's own Liouvillian mode, so this is standard Neel-Brown physics reproduced, and no measured retention datum enters anywhere. A physicist substitutes their own device's four constants and the three declared tolerances and reruns the same function.
claims.grounding: PROVENANCE "CoCrPt grain" — magnetic anisotropy, K_u ~ 2e5 J/m^3 class, stability rule K_uV/kT onset 35+/-2 and ~60 for 10-yr: Weller & Moser, IEEE Trans. Magn. 35, 4423 (1999); carrier constants LANE_T29_HDD/t29_grain.py and the DEF-A control table t29_grain.txt §3, "CONTROL — THE SAME GRAIN UNDER DEF-A, THE EXACT CLAUSES (D-15)" (sealed)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — O-51 is unaudited by T-9 and C-69 is marked SINGLE-CARRIER (macrospin-CoCrPt); the clause evaluation is exhibited on one surface. C-69 was demoted from PROVED by the solidity review on 2026-08-20, and its demotion note carries what the numbers do not: the law actually verified is tau = 1/(g_up+g_dn) = exp(E_b/kT)/(2 f0 cosh(dE/2kT)), the agreement is an identity of the construction, and external-data contact lives in T-41's lane rather than in this block. Clause (i') is asserted, not computed, and the gate covers (ii')-(v') only — so an analog record, which the census's (i) tally says has no involution to test at all, would be passed on (i') by assertion. Of the anchor's tolerance tuple (T, t_m, delta, t_w, Delta, W, N_r): its members are defined in LANE_GR4_DERIVE/GR4_DERIVATION.md §4, whose seven are T, t_m, delta, t_w, the smallest free-energy barrier ΔF‡, the attempt rate nu and the fragment count N_r — the anchor writes W, the write work, where GR4 writes nu. ProjectModel.clauses consumes T and Delta (as E_b) from the surface and t_m, C_v, W as declared inputs, returns delta = hbar/t_m, and uses neither t_w nor N_r; N_r is the parameter of GR4's clause (vi'), redundancy, which the amended set never adopted. The (ii') margin is quoted under the activation-energy convention now in the model; the sealed T-29 table's 1.78e8x predates that correction. This same named grain appears at three constant pairs across the lanes this layer cites — K_u = 2.0e5 J/m^3 with V = 1.26e-24 m^3 here and in the URM, K_u = 5e5 with V = 5.0e-25 in the GR1 census (the same barrier, 61 kT), and K_u = 3e5 in GR2 (0.75 eV, 29 kT) — all inside the declared 2-7e5 J/m^3 literature range, each lane stating its verdict insensitive within it. The block states that a named real surface satisfies the program's own definition; it says nothing about why that definition is the right one.

claims.headline: the amendment was forced by measurement: zero of ~20 real records pass the exact clauses
claims.prose: The five exact clauses were tested against thirteen real records — HDD grain, AgBr latent image, zircon U-Pb, CMB photon polarisation, latched CMOS pointer, mica fission track, DNA base pair, potentiated synapse, tree ring, lava-flow TRM, flash floating gate, ice-core bubble, footprint in rock — and zero satisfy all five. The tallies are clause by clause: (i) 8 of 13 discrete, the five that fail being the analog records — zircon ratio, synapse weight, tree ring, ice core, footprint, with the TRM ensemble direction noted alongside — where the census's own reading is that the failure is not harmless, since no involution exists to test and the definition is silent on those records instead of false of them; (ii) 13 of 13 in O-5's width form, delta = hbar/tau running 1e-41 to 1e-52 J, at least 20 orders below every relevant energy scale; (iii) 9 clean fails, records storing their value in states 0.2 eV to MJ apart; (iv) 12 of 13 fail, real write costs running 60x to 3e27x kT ln2; (v) 13 of 13 fail against an explicit single-region eraser — at a finite price in twelve, including the 254 nm UV that is the commercial EPROM eraser, and at ~zero energy for the thirteenth, the CMB photon, which has no barrier because it is protected by exact degeneracy. The positive controls beside that zero are two, and they sit in two different lanes: in the GR1 census table the CMB photon passes (i)-(iv) exactly and dies on (v) at essentially zero cost, and in GR4's own corpus B-L passes (ii) exactly and fails (iv) because nature contains no writer for it — so neither instrument is returning a blanket fail. That second corpus is seven records — FePt grain, DNA base, NAND flash, ink on paper, K-Ar geochronometer, photographic latent image, B-L — of which DNA, flash and the latent image are record types already among the thirteen, and it returns the same headline. Across four adversarially checked censuses covering ~20 records the count of exact-clause passes stays at zero while all pass the amended clauses. The word "measurement" in this block's headline means exactly this: published material constants and lane arithmetic over those named records, with no new data taken and no instrument run.
claims.grounding: LANE_GR1_CENSUS/CENSUS_V001.md tallies, Findings 1-3, the record x clause table (row 4, the CMB photon: "the same local waveplate flips it at ~zero energy") and "NUMBERS I AM UNSURE OF", with numbers.txt (13 records, sealed); LANE_GR4_DERIVE/GR4_DERIVATION.md §3 (7 records, sealed); LANE_GR2_PROTECTION, LANE_GR3_WRITING (sealed)
claims.scope: C-66 carries the TWO-CARRIER mark (macrospin-CoCrPt; NAND-floating-gate). This is census measurement narrated from sealed lanes: no URM function and no validator gate carries it, because the exact-clause evaluation lives in the lane scripts and the URM implements only the amended clauses. Against D-25(3) that is this layer's largest hole — the one fact the whole definition rests on is the one a physicist handed the model cannot rerun through it. The amended-clause pass is computed through the model for one surface (P-DEF-1) and asserted from the lane tables for the rest of the census set. "Measurement" here means published material constants and lane arithmetic; no new data was taken. Census inputs carry the lanes' own declared uncertainty, quoted at the width the lane quotes — CoCrPt K_u used at 5e5 J/m^3 within a 2-7e5 literature range, latent-image regression tau ~3e7 s and, in the census's words, fine anywhere in 1e6-1e9 s, fission-track stored energy bounded 1e4-1e6 eV with (iii) failing at any point in that range — and the lanes state that no verdict in the table moves inside those ranges. The (v) tally is 13 of 13 fails, but not 13 barriers: the census quotes an eraser price for every record and an E_b/kT for six of them, and the CMB photon's price is ~zero (P-DEF-3). The block says the world's records fail the exact clauses; it does not say the amended clauses are the right repair.

claims.headline: the mechanism mismatch is structural, and it is why the exact clauses failed
claims.prose: Exact clauses (ii) and (iii) are jointly unsatisfiable in generic matter: a non-degenerate spectrum with [R,H] = 0 forces R = f(H), which (iii) forbids, so exact (ii)+(iii) require symmetry or engineered degeneracy. Every carrier in this program's corpus was built degenerate; the census's thermally protected records are held by metastable barriers instead, with an E_b/kT quoted for six of the thirteen — ~40-60 (CMOS latch, while powered), ~50 (DNA glycosidic bond), 61 (CoCrPt HDD grain), ~120 (3.1 eV flash oxide), 220 (zircon Pb diffusion, which is thermal even though the U-Pb clock it protects is not — P-DEF-8 declines on the clock, not on the barrier), 780 (single-domain magnetite) — and six more erased by a named local operation for which the census quotes a price but no ratio. The thirteenth record is not barrier-held at all, and it sharpens this block's claim rather than weakening it: the CMB photon in free flight is protected by exact degeneracy, [H_free,R] = 0 on a polarisation doublet degenerate at fixed k, and it is the census's only exact pass on (i)-(iv) — and it dies on (v) precisely because degeneracy carries no barrier, the same local waveplate flipping it at ~zero energy. A support-compression argument closes the other half: if a record's two states differ only inside a contractible region — which is what local readability means, and every census record is read by a local probe — then a flipper supported on that region exists, so clauses (iv) and (v) are co-satisfiable only on non-contractible supports. The toric code is the control that keeps that corollary from being vacuous: its logical states have equal reduced states on every contractible region, so its record support is a cycle no contractible region contains, and the corollary discriminates instead of forbidding everything. Nature's near misses stay energetic — the superconducting flux quantum, and superfluid vortices, winding and domain walls of the same structure, are flipped by a local phase slip over a finite barrier, 0.27 eV in the sealed case — and nature's genuinely (v)-protected quantities, Chern number and baryon number, have no writer at all.
claims.grounding: LANE_GR1_CENSUS/CENSUS_V001.md Finding 1 and Finding 3 (the six quoted E_b/kT: 61, ~120, ~50, 220, 780, ~40-60) and the record x clause table row 4, the CMB photon ("P exact [H_free,R]=0"; "P exact polarisation doublet degenerate at fixed k"; "F the same local waveplate flips it at ~zero energy"), with numbers.txt (sealed); LANE_GR2_PROTECTION/GR2_PROTECTION_CENSUS.md §0 (support-compression, Uhlmann purification, and the toric-code escape) and its protection summary table, R10 (flux quantum, ΔF ≈ 0.27 eV) with vortices, winding and domain walls listed as the same structure, sealed; LANE_GR4_DERIVE/GR4_DERIVATION.md §2
claims.scope: C-66 carries the TWO-CARRIER mark (macrospin-CoCrPt; NAND-floating-gate); C-68, which carries the support-compression half, is marked SINGLE-CARRIER (macrospin-CoCrPt), so the theorem's instantiation rests on one carrier. No URM function and no validator gate carries the support-compression argument; it is narration of the sealed GR2 lane. C-66's ITEM registers "all thirteen real records surveyed are protected by metastable barriers instead, E_b/kT from 50 to 780", and that is wider than its own census in two ways — the table quotes a ratio for six of the thirteen and its low end is ~40 (the latch), not 50, and row 4, the CMB photon, has no barrier at all and is degeneracy-protected, which is the very mechanism the row says nature does not use. The row is owed an erratum on the C-16 and G-10 precedent; this block states the census table and not the row's summary. C-68's ledger text reads "nature's one non-contractible record", while its own lane's summary table lists superfluid vortices, winding and domain walls as the same structure — so this block states the class and drops the count, and the count in the row is not repeated here. The barrier ratio quoted for the CoCrPt grain, 61, is the GR1 census's number; the GR2 lane cited here runs the same named grain at K_u = 3e5 J/m^3, K_uV ≈ 0.75 eV ≈ 29 kT. The nondegenerate-commutant fact and the Neel/Brown barrier physics are standard and borrowed; the joint-unsatisfiability statement and the support-compression corollary are the program's. This is a statement about which mechanism the exact clauses formalise; it establishes nothing about what a correct definition must contain.

claims.headline: durability is |lambda| <= 1/t_m on the record's own Liouvillian mode
claims.prose: Clause (ii') is durability to t_m, read as |lambda| <= 1/t_m on the record's own Liouvillian mode, using the full eigenvalue and not its real part: an observable with lambda = i*omega does not decay, it rotates, so its value oscillates and it is not durable, and with no dissipation -i[H,.] is anti-Hermitian, every eigenvalue is purely imaginary, and a |Re lambda| filter admits everything. The mode must be the record's own. For a two-state surface the coherences relax at (g_up+g_dn)/2 while the population difference — which is what the record is — relaxes at (g_up+g_dn), so the Liouvillian's globally slowest non-zero mode overstates the lifetime by exactly a factor 2. grounded.clause_ii projects the record operator onto the adjoint Liouvillian, and returns the rate, the lifetime 1/rate, the verdict against 1/t_m, and delta = hbar/t_m, which is O-5's energy-side statement of the same bound; on the gated grain it returns 3.965e-18 /s and delta = 3.341e-43 J.
claims.grounding: LANE_T28_LIMIT/t28_limit.txt (sealed; the |lambda| reading and its dissipative control); LANE_T29_HDD/t29_grain.txt (sealed; the grain's clause-(ii') row and the independent 10-year t_m)
claims.scope: C-75 carries the TWO-CARRIER mark (steane-713; spin-chain). The reading is a stipulated tolerance convention, registered as such at O-5: it says how clause (ii) relaxes, and it is not itself a proved result. The numerical floor in slow_modes is a stated numerical tolerance and not a physical one. Durability here is passive; the census's three maintained records — the powered latch, in-vivo DNA, the potentiated synapse — have their value restored by the jump operators, which this reading does not cover.

claims.headline: DEF-A is the verified corner of the same definition
claims.prose: DEF-A — T -> 0, t_m -> infinity, write work W = 0, E_b -> infinity, with admissibility [U,H] = 0 — is the corner of the amended definition, and one half of the reduction is computed rather than asserted: the t_m -> infinity, no-dissipation half. ProjectModel.corner returns the count of slow modes at t_m = infinity beside the independently computed commutant dimension sum_E m_E^2, and the two agree on three carriers: 96/96 on [[4,2,2]], 1536/1536 on [[6,4,2]], 24/24 on the three-qubit Ising chain. The positive control beside those equalities is dissipative: with a jump operator present the slow set is monotone in t_m and strictly smaller than the commutant at long t_m, 1 of 2 at t_m = 1e9 and 1e3, so the instrument separates the limit from the general case; in the same run clause (ii') reduces to clause (ii) with rate and ||[H,R]|| both 0.00e+00. The T -> 0, W = 0 and E_b -> infinity limits — the reductions of (iii'), (iv') and (v') — are asserted and computed nowhere. Every corner-tier theorem in this program is a theorem about this limit of one definition, and DEF-A is not a second definition.
claims.grounding: LANE_T28_LIMIT/t28_limit.txt (sealed; three carriers with the dissipative control, dims 96/1536/24)
claims.scope: FORMAL — C-75 carries the TWO-CARRIER mark (steane-713; spin-chain) and O-51 is unaudited by T-9. DEF-A is the program's own idealisation and this block says nothing about the world; the census found approximately zero of its residents. Only one of the corner's four limits is computed. Nothing in T-28 or in the URM reduces (iii'), (iv') or (v') to (iii), (iv) or (v), and the E_b -> infinity limit of (v') is asserted in census prose. The equality is checked on three finite-dimensional carriers with no dissipation, and C-75's two audited carriers, steane-713 and spin-chain, are not the gated dimensions, which come from [[4,2,2]], [[6,4,2]] and a 3-qubit Ising chain. The gate name is the run-time value of the loop's f-string at model/validate_project.py:62; the same check fires for [[6,4,2]] and 3q Ising. The closing sentence scopes the corner rows and is not a new result.

claims.headline: clause (v) carries a carrier; clauses (i)-(iv) are carrier-free
claims.prose: Clauses (i)-(iv) are computable from (H,{L_k}) alone. Clause (v) is not: it quantifies over single contractible regions, and what counts as a region is carrier data, so any claim resting on (v) inherits a carrier. record_model.RecordModel.protection raises NotImplementedError instead of supplying a default locality, which puts that inheritance in code. On the canonical carrier the reading needs no convention: across 1480 regions at L = 3..6 on the toric code, the 874 contractible regions carrying a logical operator number zero, against all 606 non-contractible regions carrying one as the positive control, and dim(V/S) equals rank chi(V) for every region. The carrier's automorphism group is 8L^2 exactly where it was computed, so the carrier is not permutation-symmetric and contains geometry to detect. On a 1D open chain clause (v) fails outright — the smallest flipping contractible region is exactly w = n at every n = 3..14 — and the ring reading that rescues it is a stipulated convention scoped to a boundary-constrained proxy.
claims.grounding: model/record_model.py (the protection() refusal); LANE_O50_A_ACTION/s4c_clause_v.txt (sealed; the exact F_2 region census at L = 3..6, 36+144+400+900 regions) and s1_toric_f2.txt (Aut at L = 2,3,4 = 32, 72, 128, permutation_symmetric False); LANE_O48_D_CLAUSES/o48_part4_clausev.txt (the 1D open-chain proxy control, 630 cross-checks)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — C-74 is marked SINGLE-CARRIER (toric-2x2) and C-15 and D-23 are unaudited by T-9, so no cited row carries a two-carrier mark. The 1480-region result is corner-tier and exact on the toric code; the toric-code homology it uses is standard and borrowed, the exhaustive region census and the Aut count are the program's. Aut = 8L^2 was verified at L = 2, 3, 4 — 32, 72, 128 — and not across the L = 3..6 range the region census covers. The census itself lives in the sealed LANE_O50_A_ACTION and nowhere in the URM: model/geometry.py carries the C-77 through C-83 machinery and no clause-(v) region census, so record_model.RecordModel.protection carries this block's headline refusal and not its evidence, and no validator gate in validate_project.py or validate_geometry.py fires on the block. The 1D convention is a stipulation decided by the principal and not a measurement, and every result depending on it is scoped to the proxy.

claims.headline: the D-25 provenance gate is a tool refusal, tested in the validator
claims.prose: URM.surface is the model's public constructor and it refuses. A world-tier RecordSurface with no provenance raises ValueError and no object is returned; a corner carrier that does not self-declare provenance = 'DEF-A' raises the same, so the exact idealisation cannot silently pose as the world. Three validator gates exercise the refusals themselves — two constructor calls that must raise, one that must return the registry's pinned source — so the guard executes on every run. The registry pins three of its six world-tier surfaces to a named source: the CoCrPt grain to Weller & Moser, IEEE Trans. Magn. 35, 4423 (1999); the NAND floating gate to a charge-detrapping E_a ~ 1.0 eV with the JEDEC 1-year/30 C client EOL spec; azobenzene to t1/2 = 1.4 d in benzene at 35 C with dH = 21.1 kcal/mol = 0.915 eV (ACS Cent. Sci., PMC9951306). The other three — DNA base tautomer, Fe(II) spin crossover, alanine enantiomer — carry a source class only. And RecordSurface remains constructible directly: model/validate_project.py builds the gated grain and all six T-33 surfaces that way, so the guard covers the URM's public entry point and not the numbers this proof narrates.

claims.grounding: model/project_model.py PROVENANCE registry (six entries) and URM.surface; ledger/status_ledger.tsv D-25, the three enforcement stages verbatim; LANE_T41_EXTERNAL/CITATIONS.md (Weller & Moser 1999; NAND detrapping E_a ~ 1.0 eV with the JEDEC 1-yr/30 C EOL spec; ACS Cent. claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — C-85 is marked NOT-CARRIER-SHAPED in the T-9 audit and D-25 and D-26 are unaudited doctrine rows, so no cited row carries a two-carrier mark. The gate constrains how surfaces enter the model and establishes nothing about any surface's physics. Enforcement is partial in two named ways. First, the public gate is bypassable and is bypassed inside the proof's own validator: model/validate_project.py constructs RecordSurface directly at line 20 for the very grain P-DEF-1 narrates and at lines 43-44 for all six T-33 surfaces, so not one number narrated in this layer passed through the guard; the sealed lanes predate the gate and do the same. Second, D-25's stage (2) — the source-pinned external anchors carried as gated checks — is met only as a substring test on the registry entry ("Weller" in provenance); no validator places a pinned external measurement beside a model number, and that contact lives in T-41's lane, outside the URM. D-25's third stage is the standard this whole document is measured against and it is a stage, not a result: "THE MODEL IS THE OVERALL REPRESENTATION OF THE PROOF: PROOF_V002 is structured as the model's narration — every proof step a model function with its validator gate and its grounding". The blocks in this layer whose gate cell reads none — P-DEF-2, P-DEF-3, P-DEF-6, P-DEF-9 — do not meet it, and each says so in its own scope cell. Two further gates cover the corner self-declaration and the registry lookup; the one named here is the world-tier refusal.

claims.headline: the instrument returns None outside its declared scope
claims.prose: The definition's instrument returns None where a surface falls outside its scope. A zircon U-Pb surface is not thermally activated — nuclear decay is temperature-independent, and E_b/kT would be 1.65e8 — so the rates are unrepresentable and the model returns None; a CMB photon in free flight has no bath and no relaxation rate, and returns None again. ProjectModel.clauses returns applies = False with its stated reason on the same two surfaces, because both route through the surface's open_system() construction. The positive control beside those two nulls is a different configuration through the same entry point: six thermally activated surfaces — magnetic anisotropy, trapped charge, chemical bond, spin-state transition, photoisomerisation, parity violation — on which every value returns, worst absolute error 1.98e-15 on the steady value and worst relative error 3.97e-16 on the lifetime. Those two figures are the live validator's; the sealed T-33 table reports 1.35e-15 and 2.40e-16 under the pre-correction rate convention, so a reader following the sealed source alone will find a mismatch. What the control establishes is that the instrument returns where the physics is representable and declines where it is not. It does not establish mechanism-independence: the T-9 audit reads the six as six scalar parameter sets in one identical 2x2 GKSL model, detailed balance forces the steady-state form before any physics is consulted, and C-70's demotion note withdraws two of the six parameter rows.
claims.gate_name: T-33 declines on the CMB photon
claims.grounding: LANE_T33_ANYSURFACE/t33_anysurface.txt (sealed; the six-mechanism table at worst 1.35e-15 abs and 2.40e-16 rel, and the two declines); the 1.98e-15 / 3.97e-16 pair is the live run of model/validate_project.py, checks "T-33 law 1 on six mechanisms" and "T-33 law 2 on six mechanisms"; LANE_GR1_CENSUS/CENSUS_V001.md entries 3 and 4 (zircon, CMB photon)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — C-85 is marked NOT-CARRIER-SHAPED and C-67 and C-70 are both marked SINGLE-CARRIER (macrospin-CoCrPt), so no cited row carries a two-carrier mark. The named gate asserts the decline through .lifetime(); .clauses() declines on the same two surfaces by the same construction, which the gate does not separately assert. C-70's demotion note withdraws two of the six control rows: azobenzene, whose computed lifetime under the then-current midpoint convention contradicted the measured cis lifetime by five to six orders — that convention has since been corrected in the model, and T-41 pins the surface to published data — and alanine, whose dE = 1e-13 eV sits about five orders above the PVED range the model's own registry carries. Excluding alanine alone the six rows span dE/kT 2.1 to 23.2, but 23.21 is azobenzene's, the other withdrawn row; on the four rows C-70 leaves standing the checked span is dE/k_B T = 2.10 to 13.10, a factor 6.2 (P-LAW-3). The twelve-order span the sealed table quotes rests on the withdrawn alanine value. A decline is a statement about the instrument's declared scope and is not a statement about whether the surface is a record: C-67 records that the CMB photon's polarisation satisfies exact clauses (i)-(iv) and fails (v). The zircon decline is about its clock and not about its protection: the census quotes a thermal Pb-diffusion barrier of 220 kT for the same surface (P-DEF-3).

claims.headline: H-3 stands PARTIAL: why THIS definition is unanswered
claims.prose: The clauses are the program's own stipulation. Taking the requirement head-on — a present observable whose value licenses an inference about an earlier event, I(X : R(t_m)) >= (1-delta) H(X), read without destroying the correlation for the next observer — yields seven necessary conditions: five matching clauses (i)-(v) in kind, and two that no clause states — redundancy and readability, which is quantum Darwinism's entire content, and the arrow, the low-entropy initial condition without which no present state licenses any inference about the past. One thing does not follow at all: that the record be a fixed operator. The world's longest-lived records survive by migrating substrate, over which no operator approximately commutes with the dynamics, so the five clauses hard-code a special case. The same exercise locates the clauses in the existing literature: clause (ii) is exact einselection, clauses (i)+(iv)+(v) are a logical-Pauli pair with a distance condition, and clause (iii) is the program's own sharpening. The census answered with a number whether the world's records meet the clauses, and the amendment changed that answer; nothing in this layer derives the clauses from a prior principle, so H-3 stands PARTIAL with "why THIS definition" as its open question.

claims.headline: the definition discriminates: same H, different jumps, records against no records
claims.prose: The URM decides the clauses from (H,{L_k}) and nothing else — no lattice, no gauge group, no temperature, no coupling, no code, no geometry is supplied — and it separates. On H = diag(0,0,1,1) with one generic jump operator, record_model.RecordModel.records returns zero records summed over six draws. The positive control beside that zero is a different configuration on the identical Hamiltonian: the same H with a diagonal jump returns records in all six draws, so the zero is the jump operators' doing and not the degeneracy's. A second pair sharpens which property is decisive. Two jump legs whose noise vanishes identically inside every eigenspace — max ||P_E L P_E|| = 0.000e+00, so nothing acts within the degenerate subspace — still leave zero records, and deleting the return legs restores them. Both pairs are C-12's repaired converse read off in code: a record exists exactly when the commutant of alg{I,H,L_k,L_k†} holds a projection non-trivial on some eigenspace and trace-balanced, and a generic or excursion-and-back jump set collapses that commutant while a diagonal one does not.
claims.gate_name: H=diag(0,0,1,1) + diagonal L: records found in all 6 draws

FORMAL, and corner-tier: these are DEF-A's exact clauses on constructed 4-dimensional carriers, not the amended clauses on a real surface, and the block says nothing about the world. What discriminates here is the jump set at fixed H; this is not a discrimination between real record surfaces, and no census record was run through it. The gate named here is in model/validate_model.py, a third validator section 0.3 does not name and which neither of the two it does name chains; it is fired by replicate/on_finding.sh step 4 as a whole-file pass, 12 PASS and 0 FAIL, so a reader following section 0.3's four commands alone never runs this gate. The sealed LANE_P1_DEFINITION table exhibits the same separation on the toric code and is gated nowhere in the URM. O-1, the obstruction these two control pairs instantiate, stands FAILED in the ledger and is deliberately not cited.
